title: TUI plugin: sidebar Jira-like view with create button
objective: Build an opencode v2 plugin rendering into the sidebar: Jira-like ticket view, context detection for tickets being worked on, phased todo list, expanded board view, and a prominent Create button for users to quickly set up draft tickets

acceptance_criteria.text: The plugin renders a Jira-like ticket view in the sidebar.
The plugin detects which tickets the agent is working on from session context.
The active ticket shows a phased todo list and related ticket statuses.
The board view expands to show all tickets and context-filtered tickets.
A prominent Create button sets up draft tickets.
Added JSX obeys the OpenTUI text rules and passes tests/tui-jsx.bats.
